normative_extracts.quote: Registering a custom property with a syntax other than * enables the user agent to type-check values and interpolate them in animations and transitions.

browser_support.notes: Baseline Newly Available (July 2024). Untyped custom properties remain opaque token streams.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Typed custom properties parse into CSSOM value types instead of raw token strings, unlocking interpolation and disabling inheritance when inherits: false.

production_failures.symptom: Animating a CSS gradient using --stop-color snaps abruptly at 50% instead of fading
production_failures.root_cause: Unregistered custom properties are treated as untyped token sequences that cannot be interpolated.
production_failures.mitigation: Register the variable with @property --stop-color { syntax: "<color>"; inherits: false; initial-value: #000; }.

production_failures.symptom: @property rule is silently ignored by the browser
production_failures.root_cause: Omitting initial-value when syntax is not "*" makes the entire @property at-rule invalid per spec.
production_failures.mitigation: Always provide all three descriptors (syntax, inherits, initial-value) for typed properties.
